name: Kuze Madoka
source:
Flaw: Scandal-maker

‘What?~ You wanna play with me?
Maybe if I get the time.’

1st year high-school student. Heir to his family and [url=/c42612]Kasumi’s[/url] elder twin brother. Formerly a famous child actor, he now does random acting jobs and goes around having fun all the time. He often appears in the commercials of companies related to or sponsored by his family business. Possibly due to the fact that he was often praised as a child, his personality has taken a turn for the worse — he is not only quick to start fights, but also a scandal-maker. However, because he’s good looking, he remains popular.
